samples.xml_description:
<module id="accu">
    <description>A module to accumulate 4 input data_in values and produce a 10-bit result stored in data_out.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock input for synchronization.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal.</input>
        <input id="data_in" width_description="[7:0]">8-bit input data for addition.</input>
        <input id="valid_in">Input signal indicating readiness for new data.</input>
        <output id="valid_out">Output signal indicating when 4 input data accumulation is reached.</output>
        <output id="data_out" width_description="[9:0]">10-bit output data representing the accumulated sum.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <!-- Define any necessary parameters here -->
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        // Sequential logic for accumulator functionality
        reg [9:0] accum_data;
        reg [3:0] counter;
        reg valid_out_reg;
        
        always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n) begin
            if (!rst_n) begin
                accum_data <= 0;
                counter <= 0;
                valid_out_reg <= 0;
            end else begin
                if (valid_in == 1 && counter < 4) begin
                    accum_data <= accum_data + {2'b0, data_in};
                    counter <= counter + 1;
                end
                
                if (counter == 4) begin
                    valid_out_reg <= 1;
                    counter <= 0;
                    accum_data <= 0;
                end else begin
                    valid_out_reg <= 0;
                end
            end
        end
        
        assign data_out = accum_data;
        assign valid_out = valid_out_reg;
    </logic_description>
    
    <implementation>

            end else begin

                    counter <= counter + 1;
                end
                
                if (counter == 4) begin
                    valid_out_reg <= 1;
                    counter <= 0;
                    accum_data <= 0;
                end else begin
                    valid_out_reg <= 0;
                end
            end
        end
        
        assign data_out = accum_data;
        assign valid_out = valid_out_reg;
    </implementation>

        // Task definitions can go here if needed
    </task>
</module>
